name: coder-delegation
description: Evidence-driven multi-role coding: Architect verifies a superpowers-approved plan, defines bounded-autonomy Coder units and arbitrates disputes; Coder implements within explicit validation and Java backend boundaries; independent codex/opencode/mico review is supported.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-driven bounded Coder with Architect arbitration.
interface.longDescription: Architect reuses a technical design and implementation plan produced through superpowers, verifies current repository facts, and creates a self-contained v2 task contract with explicit autonomy and escalation boundaries. Coder makes evidence-backed local implementation decisions, records structured disputes, runs a strict validation allowlist, follows selected Java backend rules, and self-reviews. Architect independently verifies evidence and coordinates optional codex/opencode/mico blind review with zcode fallback.
defaultPrompt: Use cdel to implement this feature.
cdel: add permission check to UserService
